question: open restaurants belem
sql: SELECT names.primary AS name, basic_category, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geom FROM lisbon_places WHERE basic_category = 'restaurant' AND operating_status = 'open' AND ST_Within(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.23, 38.69, -9.19, 38.71)) LIMIT 50;

question: civic buildings lisbon centre
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, class, num_floors, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geom FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE subtype = 'civic' AND ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.15, 38.70, -9.12, 38.73)) LIMIT 50;

question: pharmacies inside tall buildings
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.names.primary AS name, b.num_floors, ST_AsGeoJSON(p.geometry) AS geom FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Within(p.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category = 'pharmacy' AND b.height >= 30 LIMIT 50;

question: closed shops alfama
sql: SELECT names.primary AS name, basic_category, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geom FROM lisbon_places WHERE operating_status = 'permanently_closed' AND ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.14, 38.70, -9.12, 38.72)) LIMIT 50;

question: adjacent residential buildings
sql: SELECT a.id AS id_a, b.id AS id_b, ST_AsGeoJSON(a.geometry) AS geom_a, ST_AsGeoJSON(b.geometry) AS geom_b FROM lisbon_buildings a JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON a.id < b.id AND ST_Touches(a.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE a.subtype = 'residential' AND b.subtype = 'residential' LIMIT 50;

question: schools in education buildings
sql: SELECT p.names.primary AS school_name, b.class, ST_AsGeoJSON(b.geometry) AS building_geom FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category = 'school' AND b.subtype = 'education' LIMIT 50;
